newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Gas 1997 estimate lowered. [CORRECTED 23:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pacific Gas 1997 estimate lowered. [CORRECTED 23:22 GMT]

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc on Monday said it lowered its fiscal 1997 earnings estimates for Pacific Gas and Electric Co to $1.90 a share from $2.00 and its fiscal 1998 estimate to $2.00 from $2.05 to reflect higher effective tax rates.

-- EVEREN said its original estimates were already below consensus forecasts. The revised estimates followed a conference call in which Pacific Gas officials discussed the company's fiscal 1997 (corrects year from 1987) EPS target of $1.87, on which its employee compensation package will be based.
-- An expected gain on the sale of the utility's ENERGEN international power subsidiary was not included in the estimates by the company or by EVEREN.
-- Shares of Pacific Gas, the largest investor-owned utility in the United States, were down 1-1/4 at 21-3/4 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
